Name: Wizards Wardrobe - Transform Into NPCs and Villagers
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00][size=6][center]Wizard’s Wardrobe: NPC Forms 🧙‍♂️✨[/center][/size][/color][/b][center][/center][center][size=3]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/url][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=downloads][/url][/center]



Transform into vanilla NPCs (Sebastian, Haley, Abigail, and more) using [b]only existing game assets[/b].

This mod [b]hides your farmer sprite[/b] and renders a selected [b]base-game NPC sprite sheet[/b] ([code]Characters/<Name>[/code]) in its place. It’s purely visual and lightweight, designed for roleplay, screenshots, and “I woke up as Haley today” chaos.

[line][b][color=#00ff00]Features[/color]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]NPC form[/b]: your farmer becomes a chosen vanilla character sprite.
[*][b]Hotkey toggle[/b]: turn the form on/off anytime.
[*][b]Cycle characters[/b]: switch to the next form with a keybind.
[*][b]Correct depth layering[/b]: trees/fences can cover you normally (no “always on top” bug).
[/list]
[b][color=#ffff00]or you can Add your own character through config json, just need to update the name under   [/color][color=#ff7700]"CharacterName": "[/color][color=#00ffff]Sebastian[/color][color=#ff7700]",[/color]
[color=#ffff00]   . How to find name ? character folder : (Characters/[/color][color=#00ffff]Sebastian[/color][color=#ffff00])

[/b][line][b][color=#00ff00]How it works (simple explanation)
[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Uses vanilla textures like [code]Characters/Sebastian[/code]
, [code]Characters/Haley[/code], etc.[*]Your farmer’s gameplay stays the same, but the [b]visual draw is replaced[/b].
[*]Animation may look “NPC-ish” during tool use (by design), because NPC sheets don’t have farmer tool frames.
[/list][line]Default Controls[list]
[*][b]Toggle Form:[/b] [code]K[/code]
[*][b]Next Character:[/b] [code]L[/code]
[/list](You can change both in [code]config.json[/code] or GMCM.)
[line][color=#00ff00][b]Configuration[/b]
[/color]
You can set:
[list]
[*]Enabled on launch
[*]Character name (e.g. Sebastian / Haley / Abigail…)
[*]Toggle key & cycle key
[*]Opacity
[*]Position offsets (X/Y) to fine-tune alignment
[*]Multiplayer behavior (local-only recommended)
[/list][b][color=#00ff00]Supported characters
[/color][/b]
Sebastian,Haley, Abigail, Sam, Alex, Emily, Penny, Maru, Leah, Harvey, Shane, Elliott…

…and many more vanilla NPC. Or you can add to config json your own, just change the name.

[b][color=#00ff00]Compatibility: 

[/color][/b]Since the mod is visual-only, it won’t modify your save, won’t change NPC relationships/events, and won’t permanently alter your farmer. If you uninstall it, your game and save will behave exactly the same, you’ll simply go back to your normal player sprite.
